# otel-collector — LLM doc index (pinned: 1.0.2)
# One line per file; regenerate the pin on release. Read files at the tag that matches the
# running build: image tag ghcr.io/krateo-platformops/otel-collector:<tag> == this repo's git
# tag == the otel-collector-deployment chart's appVersion (no v prefix). The chart-side view
# (pipeline wiring, endpoints, RBAC) is versioned separately in krateo-platformops/clickstack-chart.
docs/index.md: the map — what this repo is + links to the whole bundle
docs/overview.md: how the binary is assembled — OCB manifest, two-stage Docker build, component table, the compositionresolver processor
docs/usage.md: how the image is consumed — installer → clickstack-chart path, direct pull, local OCB build
docs/configuration.md: the config surface this repo owns — compositionresolver keys, build-time manifest, chart boundary
docs/api.md: the contract — composition-id attribute + the fork deltas vs upstream contrib v0.118.0
docs/examples.md: index of the runnable examples
docs/release.md: how a release ships — plain-semver tag → shared multi-platform image build → GHCR
docs/log.md: curated history — forks, migrations, notable fixes
docs/internals/behavior.md: the runtime pipeline + the composition-id enrichment contract, traced at file:line
docs/internals/gotchas.md: pitfalls grounded in code/config — in-cluster-only, silent RBAC, logs-only, cache staleness, version pinning, OpAMP
examples/in-cluster-events/README.md: standalone in-cluster deploy — events → compositionresolver → debug exporter
examples/in-cluster-events/manifest.yaml: the manifest — kubectl apply -f
# Source of truth (read at the same tag):
builder-config.yaml: the OCB manifest — the exact receivers/processors/exporters/extensions (and versions) compiled in
compositionresolver/processor.go: the custom processor — resolve + cache logic
compositionresolver/config.go: typed config (cache_ttl, negative_cache_ttl, label_key) + Validate
compositionresolver/factory.go: component type, defaults, logs-only registration (alpha)
k8sobjectsreceiver/receiver.go: forked upstream receiver — the watch-recycle / restart-on-close krateo patch
clickhouseexporter/recreate_schema.go: forked upstream exporter — the UNKNOWN_TABLE (code 60) detection for schema recreation
Dockerfile: the two-stage OCB build → distroless image
